body.name: \((\Xi_0,\mathfrak F_0,\theta_1^\star,\theta_2^\star)\)
body.construction: Set \(K=2\), \(p=3\), \(J=2\), fix \(\iota(X)=i_X=1\), \(\iota(Y)=i_Y=2\), and \(\iota(Z)=i_Z=3\), and set \(M_0=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}\), \(\mathcal T_0=\{4/5,9/10,97/100\}^3\), \(\mathfrak G=\mathfrak D_3^2\), and \(\preceq_{\mathfrak G}\) to lexicographic order of the two row-major binary adjacency codes. For every \(\boldsymbol d=(d_1,d_2)\), put \(d_{\boldsymbol d}=6+|E(d_1)|+|E(d_2)|\), \(\Theta_{\boldsymbol d}=[1/2,3]^{d_{\boldsymbol d}}\), and \(\Theta^{\mathrm{in}}_{\boldsymbol d}=[3/4,5/2]^{d_{\boldsymbol d}}\), with coordinates ordered by type, then roots by node, then edges by child-parent lexicographic order. Set \(q_{31}=1\) and \(q_{sk}=2\) for every other \(s\neq k\), \(W=I_{54}\), \(\mathcal R_0=\{(1/2,1/2)\}\), \(\rho=(1/2,1/2)\), \(r_{\mathrm{id}}=1/32\), \(R=(12,28,80)\), \(s_{\mathrm{tail}}=10\), \(a_{\mathrm{TM}}=8\), \(b_{\max}=20\), \(c_{\max}=8\), \(\pi_{\mathrm{ar}}=(128,64,512,\mathtt{out})\), \(\alpha=1/20\), \(w_{\max}=1\), and \(N_{\max}=200000\); these values define the complete rational input \(\Xi_0\). Let \(D^\star=\{1\to2,1\to3,2\to3\}\), \(\boldsymbol D_0=(D^\star,D^\star)\), and let the two witness parameters have \(\mu_1=1\), \(\mu_2=2\), and every other root or present-edge coefficient equal to \(1\), giving \(V_1\sim\operatorname{Pois}(\mu_r)\), \(V_2\mid V_1=x\sim\operatorname{Pois}(1+x^2)\), and \(V_3\mid V_1=x,V_2=y\sim\operatorname{Pois}(1+x+y^2)\). The sole refinement \(\mathfrak F_0\), used only if \(\mathfrak C(\Xi_0)\) is \(\mathtt{UNDECIDED}\), replaces \(\mathcal T_0\) by \(\mathcal T_1=\mathcal T_0\cup\{3/4,17/20,19/20\}^3\), \(W\) by \(I_{108}\), \(R\) by \((16,36,96)\), \(s_{\mathrm{tail}}\) by \(12\), \(a_{\mathrm{TM}}\) by \(10\), \(b_{\max}\) by \(24\), \(c_{\max}\) by \(10\), and \(\pi_{\mathrm{ar}}\) by \((192,64,768,\mathtt{out})\), leaving every other entry fixed; the result is \(\Xi_1\), and no second refinement is admissible. The coefficient and exponent boxes are a synthetic prospective-design benchmark, not an assay-calibrated biological model.
